events.title: Sheeple 1.0
events.summary: Hello there, Sheeple!It's Leon Here, today I'm here to spotlight for you guys a 1.0 update for Sheeple. It is an absolute ton of fixes so brace yourselves!Sheeple now has Audio Settings! Yes now you can actually turn off all the audio in the game without using outside options. The army system had been overhauled. New units and new cards are in the game as well as a multiplayer system which is locked from the Demo had been added. Also the game is now available in 37 languages!Change LogDead Units

events.title: Sheeple Shops
events.summary: Hello There, Sheeple! In Sheeple, there is a Shop system that allows players to buy new units! There are 3 different shopkeepers, each with a different fraction of units they can sell. Each time you finish a battle, the amount of shopkeepers in the shop space is being randomised as well as: the shopkeepers themself, the units they are selling, and the terrain in the shop. events.title: Loading Screens
events.summary: Hello There Sheeple! Lately, on DevGamm Gdańsk Game Roast it was pointed out that the game's loading is absurdly high, the entire 7 minutes! That is why I've worked on it and the average loading time has been reduced to 1 minute. I've also added 3 new loading screen versions for a total of 4 so that the screen itself isn't overly boring and doesn't become a target of annoyance (it will I'm just postponing it) here are the Loading Screens: Cursed Heaven: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341705/51867fa0dbda3a

events.title: Sheeple Release Date
events.summary: Hello there, Sheeple! Sheeple was originally planned to be released in September. Still, because I would like to take additional time testing & polishing the game when it is in its Demo version, I've decided to delay the release up to November. The precise date of the game's release will be announced later when I work out the details. To celebrate the change of the release date into one more set in stone, I present before you a new Sheeple Battle Trailer! Have a fruitful day! Leon
